text: That doesnt make sense tho right you understand when i said that i saw them already working that it meant it was working right? so like heres the series of events today: got the painted texture from inside the editor to match in the iso3d to match in the compiled game. this was ~20 minutes before i then started this convo. somewhere in there, it stopped working. you can check the requests like right before you showing me say 'its working '
resolution: Investigated the user's report that cooked-prop paint WAS working in the compiled game and regressed. Verified there is no recent regression in the bake/loader code (only a flora commit touched worldGeometry.ts and it didn't touch the texture path). The real situation: the compiled game has TWO image paths. Face decals/uploaded images (FacePainter) ship raw encoded bytes in the MATERIALS lump and decode in the Zig loader via c.stbi_load_from_memory (decal_raster.zig) — this WORKS (proven by the user's wall-poster screenshot). Cooked-prop PAINT ships raw RGBA in the MESH_PROPS lump, requiring the v8cli bake to decode the PNG via @reactjit/image image().raw() — which returns null because v8cli never registers the __imageops_* door (proven by decoding the user's actual stored paint blob under v8cli). So cooked-prop paint renders gray while decals render fine. The correct fix routes cooked-prop paint through the working loader-decode path: ship PNG bytes in MESH_PROPS, decode in constructor.zig with stbi like decals — no v8cli rebuild.
